Hey, fellow animal lovers!🐾

Cuddle Buddies TV is a project of our main channel Cuddle Buddies. 

Here, we share animal stories in a longer format — slow down and enjoy the full journeys of your fav animals! Easy to watch on TV,  on your phone, or to share with friends.
If you want to watch our shorter 3-minute stories, please check out our main channel 👉 https://www.youtube.com/@CuddleBuddiesChannel

All stories published on Cuddle Buddies TV are created together with animal owners, with their permission and involvement.

Cuddle Buddies was created in 2022 by Iegor Bakhariev, and we’re proud to see how the project has grown from a small YouTube channel into one of the biggest animal media. Every day, our team works to bring unique animal stories to the public. Please support us if you can.

We’re always looking for new stories and partnerships. If you’re an animal organization, a media outlet, or you have a story to tell, feel free to reach out using the links below👇
